tips: Power is everything. A base running short of electricity builds and fires slowly; keep a generator ahead of demand.
Collectors are your economy. Escort them, and build a second refinery before the first field runs dry.
Hold Shift while ordering to queue waypoints. Press W to latch queueing on for a whole sequence.
Ctrl+number assigns a control group; double-tap the number to centre the camera on it.
Scattering infantry with X dodges splash damage from artillery and air strikes.
Rosters are atomic: a subfaction replaces specific units and shifts stats. Read the briefing before you commit.
Double-click a unit to select every unit of the same type on screen.
Fog of war hides everything outside your sight. Scouts and radar pay for themselves.
Selling a structure returns part of its cost instantly, a last resort when a base is about to fall.
Set a rally point by right-clicking on the ground with a producer selected in rally mode.
Repair mode restores structures for credits over time. Toggle it with R and click the damaged building.
Press Space or click the alert ribbon to jump the camera to the last alert, for example a base under attack.
Superweapons announce themselves to every player. A countdown on the ribbon means you have minutes, not seconds.
Aircraft need pads to rearm. Losing an airfield strands its fleet in the air.
Team games share victory: the match ends when only one team has assets left.
Middle mouse button drags to orbit the camera; Q and E rotate; Page Up and Page Down tilt.
